description: This Java class defines an entity for tracking the history of loan officer assignments to a loan. It includes fields for the associated loan, loan officer, start date, and end date, along with methods for creating new records, updating fields, and querying date-related information.

classes.name: LoanOfficerAssignmentHistory
classes.description: Entity representing the historical record of a loan officer assigned to a specific loan, including start and end date, with utility methods for managing and querying the assignment data.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of LoanOfficerAssignmentHistory with specified loan, loan officer, and start date.

methods.name: updateLoanOfficer
methods.description: Updates the loan officer assigned in this history record.

methods.name: updateStartDate
methods.description: Updates the start date of this assignment record.

methods.name: updateEndDate
methods.description: Updates the end date of this assignment record.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Retrieves the start date of the assignment.

methods.name: matchesStartDateOf
methods.description: Checks if the given date matches the start date of this record.

methods.name: isBeforeStartDate
methods.description: Determines if the provided date is before the start date.

methods.name: isCurrentRecord
methods.description: Indicates if this record is the current one (end date is null).

methods.name: isEndDateAfter
methods.description: Checks if the end date of this record is after the given date.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Retrieves the end date of the assignment.

methods.name: isSameLoanOfficer
methods.description: Checks if the provided staff is the same as the loan officer in this record.
